description: This file provides utility functions for extracting and formatting version information from a provided data structure, specifically handling 'version' fields which can be strings or lists. It defines functions GetVersion and GetVersionString for processing version data.

methods.name: GetVersion(info)
methods.description: Extracts a version list [major, minor, patch] from the 'info' dictionary, handling different formats for the 'version' field.

methods.name: GetVersionString(info)
methods.description: Generates a version string in 'major.minor.patch' format from the 'info' dictionary by utilizing GetVersion.
